summary: One coherent reviewable intent: eliminate 17 vacuous test/e2e files, give 2 of them real coverage, add a fail-closed lint plus its unit test and CI step, and reconcile the spec/SSOT refs the deletions invalidated. No foreign Story lineage; the only out-of-Story edits are minimal removals of test_refs pointing at files this Story deletes, which must ship in the same commit or leave the spec surface dangling. The generated split plan recommends a split, but its own merge_order lands the CI step three lanes before the npm script and implementation that define it, and its lanes cover only 40 of 43 paths, so splitting would be a regression risk. Ship as one PR.
